verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwal-hayyul-qayyoom
Nazzala alaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi wa anzalat-tawraata wal-injeel
Min qablu hudan lin-naasi wa anzalal-furqaana innal-ladheena kafaroo bi-aayaati Allaahi lahum adhaabun shadeedun Wallaahu azeezun dhun-tiqaam
Innallaaha laa yakhfaa alayhi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa
Huwal-ladhee yusawwirukum fil-arhaami kayfa yashaa'u laa ilaaha illaa huwal-azeezul-hakeem

Huwal-ladhee anzala alaykal-kitaaba minhu aayaatun muhkamaatun hunna ummul-kitaabi wa ukharu mutashaabihaatun fa-ammal-ladheena fee quloobihim zayghun fayattabi'oona maa tashaabaha minhu ibtighaa'al-fitnati wabtighaa'a ta'weelihi wa maa ya'lamu ta'weelahu illaa Allaahu war-raasikhoona fil-ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihi kullun min indi rabbinaa wa maa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab
Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa wa hab lanaa min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal-wahhaab
Rabbanaa innaka jaami'un-naasi liyawmin laa rayba feehi innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad
Innal-ladheena kafaroo lan tughniya anhum amwaaluhum wa laa awlaaduhum mina Allaahi shay'an wa ulaa'ika hum wa qoodun-naar
Kada'bi aali fir'awna wal-ladheena min qablihim kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa fa-akhadhahumu Allaahu bidhunoobihim Wallaahu shadeedul-iqaab
Qul lilladheena kafaroo satughlaboona wa tuhsharoona ilaa jahannama wa bi'sal-mihaad

Qad kaana lakum aayatun fee fi'atayni iltaqataa fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelillaahi wa ukhraa kaafiratun yarawnahum mithlayhim ra'yal-ayni Wallaahu yu'uayyidu binasrihi man yashaa'u inna fee dhaalika la-ibratan li'wlil-absaar

Zuyyina lin-naasi hubbush-shahawaati minan-nisaa wal-baneena wal-qanaateeril-muqantarati minadh-dhahabi wal-fiddati wal-khaylil-musawwamati wal-an'aami wal-harthi dhaalika mataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa Wallaahu indahu husnul-ma'aab

Qul a'uunabbi'ukum bikhayrin min dhaalikum lilladheena ittaqaw inda rabbihim jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa azwaajun mutahharatun wa ridwaanun mina Allaahi Wallaahu baseerun bil-ibaad
Al-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa qinaa adhaaban-naar
As-saabireena was-saadiqeena wal-qaaniteena wal-munfiqeena wal-mustaghfireena bil-ashaar
Shahida Allaahu annahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa wal-malaa'ikatu wa ulul-ilmi qaa'iman bil-qisti laa ilaaha illaa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Innad-deena indallaahil-islaamu wa makh-talafal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba illaa min ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-ilmu baghyan baynahum wa man yakfur bi-aayaati Allaahi fa-innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab

Fa-in haajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillahi wa manit-taba'ani wa qul lilladheena ootul-kitaaba wal-ummiyyeena a'aslamtum fa-in aslamoo faqadi ihtadaw wa in tawallaw fa-innamaa alaykal-balaaghu Wallaahu baseerun bil-ibaad
Innal-ladheena yakfuroona bi-aayaati Allaahi wa yaqtuloonan-nabiyyeena bighayri haqqin wa yaqtuloonal-ladheena ya'muroona bil-qisti minan-naasi fabashshirhum bi-adhaabin aleem
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena habitat a'maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa maa lahum min naasireen
Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseeban minal-kitaabi yud'awna ilaa kitaabillaahi liyahkuma baynahum thumma yatawallaa fareequn minhum wa hum mu'ridoon
Dhaalika bi-annahum qaaloo lan tamassanan-naaru illaa ayyaaman ma'doodaatin wa gharrahum fee deenihim maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Fakayfa idhaa jama'naahum liyawmin laa rayba feehi wa wuffiyat kullu nafsin maa kasabat wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Quli Allaahumma maalikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tashaa'u wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tashaa'u wa tu'izzu man tashaa'u wa tudhillu man tashaa'u biyadikal-khayru innaka alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Toolijul-layla fin-nahaari wa toolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa tukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wa tarzuqu man tashaa'u bighayri hisaab

Laa yattakhidhil-mu'minoonal-kaafireena awliyaa'a min doonil-mu'mineena wa man yaf'al dhaalika falaysa mina Allaahi fee shay'in illaa an tattaqoo minhum tuqaatan wa yuhadhdhirukumu Allaahu nafsahu wa ilaa Allaahil-maseer
Qul in tukhfoo maa fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu ya'lamhu Allaahu wa ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yawma tajidu kullu nafsin maa amilat min khayrin muhdaran wa maa amilat min soo'in tawaddu law anna baynahaa wa baynahu amadan ba'eedan wa yuhadhdhirukumu Allaahu nafsahu Wallaahu ra'oofun bil-ibaad
Qul in kuntum tuhibboona Allaaha fattabi'oonee yuhbibkumu Allaahu wa yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Qul atee'oo Allaaha war-rasoola fa-in tawallaw fa-innallaaha laa yuhibbul-kaafireen
Innallaaha istafaa aadama wa noohan wa aala ibraaheema wa aala imraan alal-aalameen
Dhurriyyatan ba'duhaa min ba'din Wallaahu samee'un aleem
Idh qaalati imra'atu imraana rabbi innee nadhartu laka maa fee batnee muharraran fataqabbal minnee innaka antas-samee'ul-aleem

Falammaa wada'athaa qaalat rabbi innee wada'tuhaa unthaa Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa wada'at wa laysadh-dhakaru kal-unthaa wa innee sammaytuhaa maryama wa innee u'eedhuhaa bika wa dhurriyyatahaa minash-shaytaanir-rajeem

Fataqabbalahaa rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasanin wa anbatahaa nabaatan hasanan wa kaffalahaa zakariyyaa kullamaa dakhala alayhaa zakariyyal-mihraaba wajada indahaa rizqan qaala yaa maryamu annaa laki haadhaa qaalat huwa min indi Allaahi innallaaha yarzuqu man yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Hunaalika da'aa zakariyyaa rabbahu qaala rabbi hab lee min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka samee'ud-du'aa
Fanaadathul-malaa'ikatu wa huwa qaa'imun yusallee fil-mihraabi annallaaha yubashshiruka biyahyaa musaddiqan bikalimatin mina Allaahi wa sayyidan wa hasooran wa nabiyyan minas-saaliheen
Qaala rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamun wa qad balaghaniyal-kibaru wamra'atee aaqirun qaala kadhaalika Allaahu yaf'alu maa yashaa
Qaala rabbi ij'al lee aayatan qaala aayatuka allaa tukalliman-naasa thalaathata ayyaamin illaa ramzan wadhkur rabbaka katheeran wa sabbih bil-ashiyyi wal-ibkaar
Wa idh qaalatil-malaa'ikatu yaa maryamu innallaaha istafaaki wa tahharaki wastafaaki alaa nisaa'il-aalameen
Yaa maryamu uqnutee lirabbiki wasjudee warka'ee ma'ar-raaki'een
Dhaalika min nbaa'il-ghaybi nooheehi ilayka wa maa kunta ladayhim idh yulqoona aqlaamahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wa maa kunta ladayhim idh yakhtasimoon
Idh qaalatil-malaa'ikatu yaa maryamu innallaaha yubashshiruki bikalimatin minhu usmuhul-maseehu eesab-nu maryama wajeehan fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa minal-muqarrabeen
Wa yukallimun-naasa fil-mahdi wa kahlan wa minas-saaliheen
Qaalat rabbi annaa yakoonu lee waladun wa lam yamsasnee basharun qaala kadhaaliki Allaahu yakhluqu maa yashaa'u idhaa qadaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
Wa yu'allimuhul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wat-tawraata wal-injeel

Wa rasoolan ilaa banee israa'eela annee qad ji'tukum bi-aayatin min rabbikum annee akhluqu lakum minat-teeni kahay'atit-tayri fa-anfukhu feehi fayakoonu tayran bi-idhni Allaahi wa ubri'ul-akmaha wal-abrasa wa uhyil-mawtaa bi-idhni Allaahi wa unabbi'ukum bimaa ta'kuloona wa maa taddakhiroona fee buyootikum inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan lakum in kuntum mu'minyn
Wa musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wa li-uhilla lakum ba'dal-ladhee hurrima alaykum wa ji'tukum bi-aayatin min rabbikum fattaqoo Allaaha wa atee'oon
Innallaaha rabbee wa rabbukum fa'budoohu haadhaa siraatun mustaqeem
Falammaa ahassa eesaa minhumul-kufra qaala man ansaaree ilaa Allaahi qaalal-hawaariyyoona nahnu ansaaru Allaahi aamannaa Billaahi washhad bi-annaa muslimoon
Rabbanaa aamannaa bimaa anzalta wattaba'nar-rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen
Wa makaroo wa makara Allaahu Wallaahu khayrul-maakireen

Idh qaala Allaahu yaa eesaa innee mutawaffeeka wa raafi'uka ilayya wa mutahhiruka minal-ladheena kafaroo wa jaa'ilul-ladheena ittaba'ooka fawqal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa yawmil-qiyaa mati thumma ilayya marji'ukum fa-ahkumu baynakum feemaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
Fa-ammal-ladheena kafaroo fa-u'adhdhibuhum adhaaban shadeedan fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa maa lahum min naasireen
Wa ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati fayuwaffeehim ujoorahum Wallaahu laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
Dhaalika natloohu alayka minal-aayaati wadh-dhikril-hakeem
Inna mathala eesaa indallaahi kamathali aadama khalaqahu min turaabin thumma qaala lahu kun fayakoon
Al-haqqu min rabbika falaa takun minal-mumtareen

Faman haajjaka feehi min ba'di maa jaa'aka minal-ilmi faqul ta'aalaw nad'u abnaa'anaa wa abnaa'akum wa nisaa'anaa wa nisaa'akum wa anfusanaa wa anfusakum thumma nabtahil fanaj'al la'nata Allaahi alal-kaadhibeen
Inna haadhaa lahuwal-qasasul-haqqu wa maa min ilaahin illaa Allaahu wa innallaaha lahuwal-azeezul-hakeem
Fa-in tawallaw fa-innallaaha aleemun bil-mufsideen

Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi ta'aalaw ilaa kalimatin sawaa'in baynanaa wa baynakum allaa na'buda illaa Allaaha wa laa nushrika bihi shay'an wa laa yattakhidha ba'dunaa ba'dan arbaaban min doonillaahi fa-in tawallaw faqooloo ishhadoo bi-annaa muslimoon
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima tuhaajjoona fee ibraaheema wa maa unzilatit-tawraatu wal-injeelu illaa min ba'dihi afalaa ta'qiloon
Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i haajajtum feemaa lakum bihi ilmun falima tuhaajjoona feemaa laysa lakum bihi ilmun Wallaahu ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon
Maa kaana ibraaheemu yahoodiyyan wa laa nasraaniyyan wa laakin kaana haneefan musliman wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen
Inna awlan-naasi bi-ibraaheema lalladheena ittaba'oohu wa haadhan-nabiyyu wal-ladheena aamanoo Wallaahu waliyyul-mu'mineen
Waddat taa'ifatun min ahlil-kitaabi law yudilloonakum wa maa yudilloona illaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima takfuroona bi-aayaati Allaahi wa antum tashhadoon
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima talbisoonal-haqqa bil-baatili wa taktumoonal-haqqa wa antum ta'lamoon
Wa qaalat taa'ifatun min ahlil-kitaabi aaminoo billadhee unzila alal-ladheena aamanoo wajhan-nahaari wakfuroo aakhirahu la-allahum yarji'oon

Wa laa tu'minoo illaa liman tabi'a deenakum qul innal-hudaa hudaa Allaahi an yu'taa ahadun mithla maa ooteetum aw yuhaajjookum inda rabbikum qul innal-fadla biyadi Allaahi yu'teehi man yashaa'u Wallaahu waasi'un aleem
Yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashaa'u Wallaahu dhul-fadlil-azeem

Wa min ahlil-kitaabi man in ta'manhu biqintaarin yu'uaddihi ilayka wa minhum man in ta'manhu bideenaarin laa yu'uaddihi ilayka illaa maa dumta alayhi qaa'iman dhaalika bi-annahum qaaloo laysa alaynaa fil-ummiyyeena sabeelun wa yaqooloona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba wa hum ya'lamoon
Balaa man awfaa bi-ahdihi wattaqaa fa-innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen

Innal-ladheena yashtaroona bi-ahdi Allaahi wa aymaanihim thamanan qaleelan ulaa'ika laa khalaaqa lahum fil-aakhirati wa laa yukallimuhumu Allaahu wa laa yanzuru ilayhim yawmal-qiyaamati wa laa yuzakkeehim wa lahum adhaabun aleem

Wa inna minhum lafareeqan yalwoona alsinatahum bil-kitaabi litahsaboohu minal-kitaabi wa maa huwa minal-kitaabi wa yaqooloona huwa min indi Allaahi wa maa huwa min indi Allaahi wa yaqooloona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba wa hum ya'lamoon

Maa kaana libasharin an yu'tiyahu Allaahul-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqoola lin-naasi koonoo ibaadan lee min doonillaahi wa laakin koonoo rabbaaniyyeena bimaa kuntum tu'allimoonal-kitaaba wa bimaa kuntum tadrusoon
Wa laa ya'murakum an tattakhidhul-malaa'ikata wan-nabiyyeena arbaaban aya'murukum bil-kufri ba'da idh antum muslimoon

Wa idh akhadha Allaahu meethaaqan-nabiyyeena lamaa aataytukum min kitaabin wa hikmatin thumma jaa'akum rasoolun musaddiqun limaa ma'akum latu'minunna bihi wa latansurunnahu qaala a'aqrartum wa akhadhtum alaa dhaalikum isree qaaloo aqrarnaa qaala fashhadoo wa anaa ma'akum minash-shaahideen
Faman tawallaa ba'da dhaalika fa-ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Afaghayra deenillaahi yabghoona wa lahu aslama man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi taw'an wa karhan wa ilayhi yurja'oon

Qul aamannaa Billaahi wa maa unzila alaynaa wa maa unzila alaa ibraaheema wa ismaa'eela wa ishaaqa wa ya'qooba wal-asbaati wa maa ootiya moosaa wa eesaa wan-nabiyyoona min rabbihim laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wa nahnu lahu muslimoon
Wa man yabtaghi ghayral-islaami deenan falan yuqbala minhu wa huwa fil-aakhirati minal-khaasireen
Kayfa yahdee Allaahu qawman kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim wa shahidoo annar-rasoola haqqun wa jaa'ahumul-bayyinaatu Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Ulaa'ika jazaa'uuhum anna alayhim la'nata Allaahi wal-malaa'ikati wan-naasi ajma'een
Khaalideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu anhumul-adhaabu wa laa hum yunzaroon
Illal-ladheena taaboo min ba'di dhaalika wa aslahoo fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Innal-ladheena kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim thumma izdaadoo kufran lan tuqbala tawbatuhum wa ulaa'ika humud-daalloon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa maatoo wa hum kuffaarun falan yuqbala min ahadihim mil-ul-ardi dhahaban wa law iftadaa bihi ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun aleemun wa maa lahum min naasireen
Lan tanaalul-birra hattaa tunfiqoo mimmaa tuhibboona wa maa tunfiqoo min shay'in fa-innallaaha bihi aleem
Kullut-ta'aami kaana hillan libanee israa'eela illaa maa harrama israa'eelu alaa nafsihi min qabli an tunazzalat-tawraatu qul fa'too bit-tawraati fatloohaa in kuntum saadiqeen
Famani iftaraa alaa Allaahil-kadhiba min ba'di dhaalika fa-ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Qul sadaqa Allaahu fattabi'oo millata ibraaheema haneefan wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen
Inna awwala baytin wudi'a lin-naasi lalladhee bibakkata mubaarakan wa hudan lil-aalameen
Feehi aayaatun bayyinaatun maqaamu ibraaheema wa man dakhalahu kaana aaminan wa Lillaahi alan-naasi hijjul-bayti manis-tataa'a ilayhi sabeelan wa man kafara fa-innallaaha ghaniyyun anil-aalameen
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima takfuroona bi-aayaati Allaahi Wallaahu shaheedun alaa maa ta'maloon
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima tasuddoona an sabeelillaahi man aamana tabghoonahaa iwajan wa antum shuhadaa'u wa maa Allaahu bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tutee'oo fareeqan minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba yaruddookum ba'da eemaanikum kaafireen
Wa kayfa takfuroona wa antum tutlaa alaykum aayaatu Allaahi wa feekum rasooluhu wa man ya'tasim Billaahi faqad hudiya ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha haqqa tuqaatihi wa laa tamootunna illaa wa antum muslimoon

Wa'tasimoo bihabli Allaahi jamee'an wa laa tafarraqoo wadhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum idh kuntum a'daa'an fa-allafa bayna quloobikum fa-asbahtum bini'matihi ikhwaanan wa kuntum alaa shafaa hufratin minan-naari fa-anqadhakum minhaa kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakum aayaatihi la-allakum tahtadoon
Wa ltakun minkum ummatun yad'oona ilal-khayri wa ya'muroona bil-ma'roofi wa yanhawna anil-munkari wa ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wa laa takoonoo kal-ladheena tafarraqoo wakhtalafoo min ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-bayyinaatu wa ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun azeem
Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wa taswaddu wujoohun fa-ammal-ladheena iswaddat wujoohuhum akafartum ba'da eemaanikum fadhooqul-adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Wa ammal-ladheena ibyaddat wujoohuhum fafee rahmati Allaahi hum feehaa khaalidoon
Tilka aayaatu Allaahi natloohaa alayka bil-haqqi wa maa Allaahu yureedu zulman lil-aalameen
Wa Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa ilaa Allaahi turja'ul-umoor

Kuntum khayra ummatin ukhrijat lin-naasi ta'muroona bil-ma'roofi wa tanhawna anil-munkari wa tu'minoona Billaahi wa law aamana ahlul-kitaabi lakaana khayran lahum minhumul-mu'minoona wa aktharuhumul-faasiqoon
Lan yadurrookum illaa adhan wa in yuqaatilookum yuwallookumul-adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon

Duribat alayhimudh-dhillatu ayna maa thuqifoo illaa bihablin mina Allaahi wa hablin minan-naasi wa baa'oo bighadabin mina Allaahi wa duribat alayhimul-maskanatu dhaalika bi-annahum kaanoo yakfuroona bi-aayaati Allaahi wa yaqtuloonal-anbiyaa'a bighayri haqqin dhaalika bimaa asaw wa kaanoo ya'tadoon
Laysoo sawaa'an min ahlil-kitaabi ummatun qaa'imatun yatloona aayaati Allaahi aanaa'al-layli wa hum yasjudoon
Yu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa ya'muroona bil-ma'roofi wa yanhawna anil-munkari wa yusaari'oona fil-khayraati wa ulaa'ika minas-saaliheen
Wa maa yaf'aloo min khayrin falan yukfaroohu Wallaahu aleemun bil-muttaqeen
Innal-ladheena kafaroo lan tughniya anhum amwaaluhum wa laa awlaaduhum mina Allaahi shay'an wa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Mathalu maa yunfiqoona fee haadhihil-hayaatid-dunyaa kamathali reehin feehaa sirrun asaabat hartha qawmin zalamoo anfusahum fa-ahlakathu wa maa zalamahumu Allaahu wa laakin anfusahum yazlimoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo bitaanatan min doonikum laa ya'loonakum khabaalan waddoo maa anittum qad badatil-baghdaa'u min afwaahihim wa maa tukhfee sudooruhum akbaru qad bayyannaa lakumul-aayaati in kuntum ta'qiloon

Haa'antum oolaa'i tuhibboonahum wa laa yuhibboonakum wa tu'minoona bil-kitaabi kullihi wa idhaa laqookum qaaloo aamannaa wa idhaa khalaw addoo alaykumul-anaamila minal-ghayzi qul mootoo bighayzikum innallaaha aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
In tamsaskum hasanatun tasu'uhum wa in tusibkum sayyi'atun yafrahoo bihaa wa in tasbiroo wa tattaqoo laa yadurrukum kayduhum shay'an innallaaha bimaa ya'maloona muheet
Wa idh ghadawta min ahlika tubawwi'ul-mu'mineena maqaa'ida lilqitaali Wallaahu samee'un aleem
Idh hammat taa'ifataani minkum an tafshalaa Wallaahu waliyyuhumaa wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Wa laqad nasarakumu Allaahu bibadrin wa antum adhillatun fattaqoo Allaaha la-allakum tashkuroon
Idh taqoolu lilmu'mineena alan yakfiyakum an yumiddakum rabbukum bithalaathati aalaafin minal-malaa'ikati munzaleen
Balaa in tasbiroo wa tattaqoo wa ya'tookum min fawrihim haadhaa yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati aalaafin minal-malaa'ikati musawwimeen
Wa maa ja'alahu Allaahu illaa bushraa lakum wa litatma'inna quloobukum bihi wa man-nasru illaa min indi Allaahil-azeezil-hakeem
Liyaqta'a tarafan minal-ladheena kafaroo aw yakbitahum fayanqaliboo khaa'ibeen
Laysa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba alayhim aw yu'adhdhibahum fa-innahum zaalimoon
Wa Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi yaghfiru liman yashaa'u wa yu'adhdhibu man yashaa'u Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa ta'kulur-ribaa ad'aafan mudaa'afatan wattaqoo Allaaha la-allakum tuflihoon
Wattaqun-naaral-latee u'iddat lilkaafireen
Wa atee'oo Allaaha war-rasoola la-allakum turhamoon
Wa saari'oo ilaa maghfiratin min rabbikum wa jannatin arduhas-samaawaatu wal-ardu u'iddat lilmuttaqeen
Al-ladheena yunfiqoona fis-sarraa'i wad-darraa'i wal-kaazimeenal-ghayza wal-aafeena anin-naasi Wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen
Wal-ladheena idhaa fa-aloo faahishatan aw zalamoo anfusahum dhakaroo Allaaha fastaghfaroo lidhunoobihim wa man yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Allaahu wa lam yusirroo alaa maa fa-aloo wa hum ya'lamoon
Ulaa'ika jazaa'uuhum maghfiratun min rabbihim wa jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa ni'ma ajrul-aamileen
Qad khalat min qablikum sunanun faseeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
Haadhaa bayaanun lin-naasi wa hudan wa maw'izatun lilmuttaqeen
Wa laa tahinoo wa laa tahzanoo wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'mineen

In yamsaskum qarhun faqad massal-qawma qarhun mithluhu wa tilkal-ayyaamu nudaawiluhaa baynan-naasi wa liya'lama Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa yattakhidha minkum shuhadaa'a Wallaahu laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
Wa liyumahhisa Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa yamhaqal-kaafireen
Am hasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata wa lammaa ya'lami Allaahul-ladheena jaahadoo minkum wa ya'lamas-saabireen
Wa laqad kuntum tatamannawn al-mawta min qabli an talqawhu faqad ra'aytumoohu wa antum tanzuroon

Wa maa muhammadun illaa rasoolun qad khalat min qablihir-rusulu afa'een maata aw qutila inqalabtum alaa a'qaabikum wa man yanqalib alaa aqibayhi falan yadurra Allaaha shay'an wa sayajzee Allaahush-shaakireen
Wa maa kaana linafsin an tamoota illaa bi-idhni Allaahi kitaaban mu'uajjalan wa man yurid thawaabad-dunyaa nu'tihi minhaa wa man yurid thawaabal-aakhirati nu'tihi minhaa wa sanajzish-shaakireen
Wa ka'ayyin min nabiyyin qaatala ma'ahu ribbiyyoona katheerun famaa wahanoo limaa asaabahum fee sabeelillaahi wa maa da'ufoo wa mas-takaanoo Wallaahu yuhibbus-saabireen
Wa maa kaana qawlahum illaa an qaaloo rabbanaa ighfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa alal-qawmil-kaafireen
Fa-aataahumu Allaahu thawaabad-dunyaa wa husna thawaabil-aakhirati Wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tutee'ul-ladheena kafaroo yaruddookum alaa a'qaabikum fatanqaliboo khaasireen
Bali Allaahu mawlaakum wa huwa khayrun-naasireen
Sanulqee fee quloobil-ladheena kafarur-ru'ba bimaa ashrakoo Billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sultaanan wa ma'waahumun-naaru wa bi'sa mathwaz-zaalimeen

Wa laqad sadaqakumu Allaahu wa'dahu idh tahussoonahum bi-idhnihi hattaa idhaa fashiltum wa tanaaza'tum fil-amri wa asaytum min ba'di maa araakum maa tuhibboona minkum man yureedud-dunyaa wa minkum man yureedul-aakhirata thumma sarafakum anhum liyabtaliyakum wa laqad afaa ankum Wallaahu dhoo fadlin alal-mu'mineen

Idh tus'idoona wa laa talwoona alaa ahadin war-rasoolu yad'ookum fee ukhraakum fa-athaabakum ghamman bighammin likaylaa tahzanoo alaa maa faatakum wa laa maa asaabakum Wallaahu khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon

Thumma anzala alaykum min ba'dil-ghammi amanatan nu'aasan yaghshaa taa'ifatan minkum wa taa'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona Billaahi ghayral-haqqi zannal-jaahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lanaa minal-amri min shay'in qul innal-amra kullahu Lillaahi yukhfoona fee anfusihim maa laa yubdoona laka yaqooloona law kaana lanaa minal-amri shay'un maa qutilnaa haahunaa qul law kuntum fee buyootikum labarazal-ladheena kutiba alayhimul-qatlu ilaa madaaji'ihim wa liyabtaliya Allaahu maa fee sudoorikum wa liyumahhisa maa fee quloobikum Wallaahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Innal-ladheena tawallaw minkum yawma iltaqal-jam'aani innamaa istazallahumush-shaytaanu biba'di maa kasaboo wa laqad afaa Allaahu anhum innallaaha ghafoorun haleem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena kafaroo wa qaaloo li'khwaanihim idhaa daraboo fil-ardi aw kaanoo ghuzzan law kaanoo indanaa maa maatoo wa maa qutiloo liyaj'ala Allaahu dhaalika hasratan fee quloobihim Wallaahu yuhyee wa yumeetu Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Wa la-in qutiltum fee sabeelillaahi aw muttum lamaghfiratun mina Allaahi wa rahmatun khayrun mimmaa yajma'oon
Wa la-in muttum aw qutiltum la-ilaa Allaahi tuhsharoon

Fabimaa rahmatin mina Allaahi linta lahum wa law kunta fazzan ghaleezal-qalbi laanfaddoo min hawlika fa'fu anhum wastaghfir lahum wa shaawirhum fil-amri fa-idhaa azamta fatawakkal alaa Allaahi innallaaha yuhibbul-mutawakkileen
In yansurkumu Allaahu falaa ghaaliba lakum wa in yakhdhulkum faman dhal-ladhee yansurukum min ba'dihi wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Wa maa kaana linabiyyin an yaghulla wa man yaghlul ya'ti bimaa ghalla yawmal-qiyaamati thumma tuwaffaa kullu nafsin maa kasabat wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Afamani ittaba'a ridwaana Allaahi kaman baa'a bisakhatin mina Allaahi wa ma'waahu jahannamu wa bi'sal-maseer
Hum darajaatun indallaahi Wallaahu baseerun bimaa ya'maloon

Laqad manna Allaahu alal-mu'mineena idh ba'atha feehim rasoolan min anfusihim yatloo alayhim aayaatihi wa yuzakkeehim wa yu'allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa in kaanoo min qablu lafee dalaalin mubeen
Awalammaa asaabatkum museebatun qad asabtum mithlayhaa qultum annaa haadhaa qul huwa min indi anfusikum innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa maa asaabakum yawma iltaqal-jam'aani fabi'idhni Allaahi wa liya'lamal-mu'mineen

Wa liya'lamal-ladheena naafaqoo wa qeela lahum ta'aalaw qaatiloo fee sabeelillaahi aw idfa'oo qaaloo law na'lamu qitaalan laattaba'naakum hum lilkufri yawma'idhin aqrabu minhum lil-eemaani yaqooloona bi-afwhihim maa laysa fee quloobihim Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yaktumoon
Al-ladheena qaaloo li'khwaanihim wa qa'adoo law ataa'oonaa maa qutiloo qul fadra'oo an anfusikumul-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
Wa laa tahsabannal-ladheena qutiloo fee sabeelillaahi amwaatan bal ahyaa'un inda rabbihim yurzaqoon
Fariheena bimaa aataahumu Allaahu min fadlihi wa yastabshiroona billadheena lam yalhaqoo bihim min khalfihim allaa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Yastabshiroona bini'matin mina Allaahi wa fadlin wa annallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-mu'mineen
Al-ladheena istajaaboo Lillaahi war-rasooli min ba'di maa asaabahumul-qarhu lilladheena ahsanoo minhum wattaqaw ajrun azeem
Al-ladheena qaala lahumun-naasu innan-naasa qad jama'oo lakum fakhshawhum fazaadahum eemaanan wa qaaloo hasbunaa Allaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel
Fanqalaboo bini'matin mina Allaahi wa fadlin lam yamsashum soo'un wattaba'oo ridwaana Allaahi Wallaahu dhoo fadlin azeem
Innamaa dhalikumush-shaytaanu yukhawwifu awliyaa'ahu falaa takhaafoohum wa khaafooni in kuntum mu'mineen
Wa laa yahzunkal-ladheena yusaari'oona fil-kufri innahum lan yadurroo Allaaha shay'an yureedu Allaahu allaa yaj'ala lahum hazzan fil-aakhirati wa lahum adhaabun azeem
Innal-ladheena ishtaraw al-kufra bil-eemaani lan yadurroo Allaaha shay'an wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Wa laa yahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo annamaa numlee lahum khayrun li-anfusihim innamaa numlee lahum liyazdaadoo ithman wa lahum adhaabun muheen

Maa kaana Allaahu liyadharal-mu'mineena alaa maa antum alayhi hattaa yameezal-khabeetha minat-tayyibi wa maa kaana Allaahu liyutli'akum alal-ghaybi wa laakinna Allaaha yajtabee min rusulihi man yashaa'u fa-aaminoo Billaahi wa rusulihi wa in tu'minoo wa tattaqoo falakum ajrun azeem

Wa laa yahsabannal-ladheena yabkhaloona bimaa aataahumu Allaahu min fadlihi huwa khayran lahum bal huwa sharrun lahum sayutawwaqoona maa bakhiloo bihi yawmal-qiyaamati wa Lillaahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal-ardi Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
Laqad sami'a Allaahu qawlal-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha faqeerun wa nahnu aghniyaa'u sanaktubu maa qaaloo wa qatlahumul-anbiyaa'a bighayri haqqin wa naqoolu dhooqoo adhaabal-hareeq
Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat aydeekum wa annallaaha laysa bizallaamin lil-abeed

Al-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha ahida ilaynaa allaa nu'mina lirasoolin hattaa ya'tiyanaa biqurbaanin ta'kuluhun-naaru qul qad jaa'akum rusulun min qablee bil-bayyinaati wa billadhee qultum falima qataltumoohum in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa-in kadhdhabooka faqad kudhdhiba rusulun min qablika jaa'oo bil-bayyinaati waz-zuburi wal-kitaabil-muneer
Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawti wa innamaa tuwaffawna ujoorakum yawmal-qiyaamati faman zuhziha anin-naari wa udkhilal-jannata faqad faaza wa mal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa mataa'ul-ghuroor

Latublawunna fee amwaalikum wa anfusikum wa latasma'unna minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum wa minal-ladheena ashrakoo adhan katheeran wa in tasbiroo wa tattaqoo fa-inna dhaalika min azmil-umoor
Wa idh akhadha Allaahu meethaaqal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba latubayyinunnahu lin-naasi wa laa taktumoonahu fanabadhoohu waraa'a zuhoorihim washtaraw bihi thamanan qaleelan fabi'sa maa yashtaroon
Laa tahsabannal-ladheena yafrahoona bimaa ataw wa yuhibboona an yuhmadoo bimaa lam yaf'aloo falaa tahsabannahum bimafaazatin minal-adhaabi wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Wa Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari la-aayaatin li'wlil-albaab
Al-ladheena yadhkuroona Allaaha qiyaaman wa qu'oodan wa alaa junoobihim wa yatafakkaroona fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi rabbanaa maa khalaqta haadhaa baatilan subhaanaka faqinaa adhaaban-naar
Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-naara faqad akhzaytahu wa maa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadeean yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo birabbikum fa-aamannaa rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa kaffir annaa sayyi'aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al-abraar
Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa-adtanaa alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa yawmal-qiyaamati innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad

Fastajaaba lahum rabbuhum annee laa udee'u amala aamilin minkum min dhakarin aw unthaa ba'dukum min ba'din fa-al-ladheena haajaroo wa ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa oodhoo fee sabeelee wa qaataloo wa qutiloo la-ukaffiranna anhum sayyi'aatihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru thawaaban min indi Allaahi Wallaahu indahu husnuth-thawaab
Laa yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladheena kafaroo fil-bilaad
Mataa'un qaleelun thumma ma'waahum jahannamu wa bi'sal-mihaad
Lakinil-ladheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa nuzulan min indi Allaahi wa maa indallaahi khayrun lil-abraar

Wa inna min ahlil-kitaabi laman yu'minu Billaahi wa maa unzila ilaykum wa maa unzila ilayhim khaashi'eena Lillaahi laa yashtaroona bi-aayaati Allaahi thamanan qaleelan ulaa'ika lahum ajruhum inda rabbihim innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo isbiroo wa saabiroo wa raabitoo wattaqoo Allaaha la-allakum tuflihoon
